summary.text: Margaret Croke has represented the 12th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2021.

paragraphs.text: She holds a B.A. in political science and communications from the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor.
The legislature biography lists her as a former deputy chief of staff at the Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity and says she lives in Chicago.
